purpose: Defines the canonical domain primitives, token economics, pricing matrix, and intermediate representation (IR) types for the Lumen session intelligence and Prism evaluation platforms.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-model: CanonicalTranscript, CanonicalTurn, ToolIntent, TurnRole, TurnTokenUsage, ModelPricing, TokenEconomics, ModelTokenSummary, ExecutionTiming, TrajectoryAnomaly, and SchemaCitation.
non_goals: Log file ingestion, disk I/O, or format parsing (delegated to lumen-session).
Stateful metric accumulation or anomaly detection algorithms (delegated to lumen-analysis and lumen-pattern).
Evaluation assertion grading or test execution (delegated to prism-grader).

api_surface.name: CanonicalTranscript
api_surface.signature: pub struct CanonicalTranscript { pub session_id: CompactString, pub parent_session_id: Option<CompactString>, pub orchestrator: OrchestratorKind, pub model_family: CompactString, pub timing: ExecutionTiming, pub economics: TokenEconomics, pub turns: Vec<CanonicalTurn>, pub subagents: Vec<CanonicalTranscript>, pub extracted_schemas: SmallVec<[SchemaCitation; 4]>, pub detected_anomalies: SmallVec<[TrajectoryAnomaly; 4]> }
api_surface.description: Universal normalized transcript representation holding the complete conversation tree, subagent hierarchy, token economics, and extracted schema artifacts.
error_conditions: Deserialization error if JSON payload violates field types

api_surface.name: CanonicalTurn
api_surface.signature: pub struct CanonicalTurn { pub turn_index: usize, pub role: TurnRole, pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>, pub latency_ms: u64, pub text: Option<String>, pub tool_calls: SmallVec<[CanonicalToolCall; 2]>, pub tool_results: SmallVec<[CanonicalToolResult; 2]>, pub usage: Option<TurnTokenUsage> }
api_surface.description: Normalized user, assistant, system, or tool execution turn.

api_surface.name: ModelPricing
api_surface.signature: pub struct ModelPricing { pub input_base_per_m: f64, pub cache_write_per_m: f64, pub cache_read_per_m: f64, pub output_per_m: f64 }; impl ModelPricing { pub const CLAUDE_3_5_SONNET: Self; pub const CLAUDE_3_5_HAIKU: Self; pub const CLAUDE_OPUS: Self; pub const GPT_4O: Self; pub const DEEPSEEK_R1: Self; pub const QWEN_2_5_CODER: Self; pub const KIMI_K1_5: Self; pub const GLM_4_PLUS: Self; pub const GEMINI_2_0_FLASH: Self; pub const GEMINI_2_0_PRO: Self; pub fn from_model_name(name: &str) -> Self; pub fn compute_cost(&self, usage: &TurnTokenUsage) -> f64; pub fn compute_baseline_cost(&self, usage: &TurnTokenUsage) -> f64; }
api_surface.description: Pricing rate matrix computing exact USD costs per turn and cold-cache baseline costs across major commercial LLM model families.
error_conditions: Defaults to CLAUDE_3_5_SONNET rates if model string is unrecognized

api_surface.name: TokenEconomics
api_surface.signature: pub struct TokenEconomics { pub input_tokens: u64, pub output_tokens: u64, pub cache_creation_tokens: u64, pub cache_read_tokens: u64, pub ephemeral_5m_tokens: u64, pub ephemeral_1h_tokens: u64, pub cache_hit_ratio: f32, pub total_cost_usd: f64, pub baseline_cost_no_cache_usd: f64, pub net_savings_usd: f64, pub efficiency_multiplier: f32, pub per_model: HashMap<CompactString, ModelTokenSummary> }; impl TokenEconomics { pub fn calculate(input_tokens: u64, output_tokens: u64, cache_creation_tokens: u64, cache_read_tokens: u64, model_name: &str) -> Self; }
api_surface.description: Aggregated session economics calculating exact financial costs, prompt cache hit ratios, net USD savings, and financial efficiency multipliers.
error_conditions: Sets cache_hit_ratio to 0.0 and efficiency_multiplier to 1.0 if total prompt tokens is zero

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN CanonicalTranscript is serialized to JSON and deserialized back to Rust, THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve identical struct equality with zero data loss.
WHEN computing Claude 3.5 Sonnet costs, THE SYSTEM SHALL bill uncached inputs at $3.00/M, cache creation writes at $3.75/M (1.25x), cache reads at $0.30/M (0.10x), and output tokens at $15.00/M.
WHEN computing Claude 3.5 Haiku costs, THE SYSTEM SHALL bill uncached inputs at $0.80/M, cache creation writes at $1.00/M (1.25x), cache reads at $0.08/M (0.10x), and output tokens at $4.00/M.
WHEN computing Qwen 2.5 Coder costs, THE SYSTEM SHALL bill uncached inputs at $0.20/M, cache reads at $0.05/M, and output tokens at $0.60/M.
WHEN computing prompt cache hit ratio H, THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate H = (cache_read_tokens / (input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + cache_read_tokens)) * 100.0.
WHEN computing financial efficiency multiplier eta, THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate eta = baseline_cost_no_cache_usd / total_cost_usd.
IF total prompt tokens is zero, THE SYSTEM SHALL return cache_hit_ratio of 0.0 and efficiency_multiplier of 1.0 without dividing by zero.
WHEN an unrecognized model string is passed to ModelPricing::from_model_name, THE SYSTEM SHALL default to Claude 3.5 Sonnet pricing rates.
WHEN calculating net USD savings, THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure net_savings_usd is clamped to a minimum of 0.0.
WHEN TurnTokenUsage calculates prompt_tokens, THE SYSTEM SHALL return the sum of input_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, and cache_read_tokens.

reasoning: Establishes the foundational type system, token accounting formulas, and expanded pricing matrices (Sonnet, Haiku, Opus, GPT-4o, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Gemini) required for downstream analysis.
